Put an image of your Motorhead CD here (the .bin file together with its .cue file).
You can also put it next to motorhead.exe instead.

When you start motorhead, it finds the game on the image and installs it into
this folder:

  Motorhead\    the game, with your settings and saved games
  Movies\       the videos

Please keep the CD image. The music is played from its audio tracks.

Nothing in this folder is ever deleted by motorhead.
